title: Quick and Crispy Home Fries
description: Learn how to make home fries crispy with Chef John's recipe. Precooked fries are cooled first, since a cold starch in a hot pan means a crispy exterior.
ingredients: 3 large russet potatoes, peeled and quartered
1 pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Arrange potatoes evenly on a microwave-safe plate. Microwave on high until just tender, about 4 minutes. Let cool to room temperature. Cut potatoes into bite-sized chunks.

Heat butter and olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until butter melts and starts to turn brown. Swirl the pan and add potatoes; shake the pan to arrange in an even layer. Season with paprika, cayenne, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Continue to toss potatoes and cook until reddish-brown, crusty, and crispy on the edges, 10 to 12 minutes. If potatoes are cooking too quickly, reduce the heat to medium. Garnish with chives.

video.description: Learn Chef John’s technique for creating breakfast potatoes that are perfectly crisp on the outside and baked potato-soft in the center! You can slate yourself for success by choosing a Russet or Yukon Gold potato for optimal crispiness. Then microwave to cook just until tender, cool and cut into home fries size! Cook in oil and butter then be sure to season with garlic and onion powders, paprika and cayenne peppers, and salt and pepper. Cook until crusted, crispy and beautifully browned, then load up your plate alongside eggs and toast for a perfectly great breakfast!
